system.description:
You are infected with the Watts-MacLeod strain of the exsurgent virus, which altered your brain structure and enhanced your cognitive abilities. You may learn the Psi skill ▶51 and purchase psi abilities, called sleights (▶280 and 282). At Level 1, you may only use psi-chi sleights. At Level 2, the character may use both psi-chi and psi-gamma sleights.

Psi is not without drawbacks. You must also take a negative trait according to your sub-strain ▶273 at no CP bonus. This required trait does not count towards trait CP limits.
